account.sectionIntro: You stay in control of your personal data: export it at any time, free of charge, or permanently delete your account.
account.exportDescription: Download a JSON file containing your profile, your animals (health records, routines, medications, vaccinations, measurements, breeding, history), and your notification preferences and reminders. Free for every account.
account.exportError: Could not export your data. Please try again in a moment.
account.deleteDescription: Deletion is permanent: your account, your animals and all related data are erased and cannot be recovered.
account.modalWarning: This action cannot be undone. Your account, all your animals, their health records, routines, reminders and preferences will be deleted. Consider exporting your data before you continue.
account.modalError: Deletion failed. Please try again in a moment.
account.publicIntro: You can request deletion of your Captivia account and all associated data at any time. Here is how.
account.inAppStep1: Sign in to your Captivia account.
account.inAppStep3: In the "My data" section, click "Delete my account".
account.inAppStep4: Enter your password and confirm. Your account is deleted immediately.
account.emailBody: If you can no longer sign in, email us at {email} from the address linked to your account, with the subject "{subject}". We verify your identity and delete your account within 30 days at most.
account.whatItem1: Your profile: email address, password (hashed), language, subscription and points.
account.whatItem2: All your animals and their data: health records, routines, medications, vaccinations, vet appointments, measurements, breeding records, history.
account.whatItem3: Your notification preferences, push subscriptions and reminder history.
account.backupBody: Technical backups that still contain your data are purged within 30 days at most after deletion.
account.exportInfoTitle: Get your data before you go
account.exportInfoBody: Before deleting your account, you can download a complete export of your data (JSON format) free of charge from Settings, Account, "My data".

transparency.dataPrivate: Your animals’ profiles are private by default. Public sharing of an animal is optional: you turn it on yourself and can turn it off at any time.

transparency.missionBody: Captivia helps pet owners, including owners of exotic pets, understand and care for their animals using information from open sources. This information does not replace a veterinarian’s advice.
transparency.modelAffiliation: affiliate links: some links to merchant websites, mainly Amazon, earn us a commission when you buy through them, at no extra cost to you;
transparency.modelAlwaysFree: Exporting your data and deleting your account are, and will remain, free.
transparency.modelIntro: Browsing species profiles is free. The service is funded by:
transparency.modelSubscription: an optional subscription, coming later: it is not on sale yet. Its price and terms (renewal, cancellation, right of withdrawal) will be shown before any payment.
transparency.openDataBody: Profiles rely on GBIF, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Species+ (CITES), PubMed, Open Pet Food Facts, iNaturalist and Encyclopedia of Life. These sources receive no personal data from us.
